housing: Birmingham's rentals are mostly older single-family houses and bungalows, apartments near UAB on the Southside, and lofts in converted downtown buildings.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Services Alabama
tenantHelp.what: free civil legal help for low-income renters, including evictions and repairs

climate: Test the air conditioning and look for leaks, damp and mold; summers are hot and humid and spring storms are frequent.
fact: UAB is the largest employer in Alabama, and many Southside renters work or study there.
